question:
The bar graph given below shows the cost price and selling price of four articles L, M, N and O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92744fad88521f12e9460c4ecdbcd11e043a23e3b5bf4736247637a531498076.png] 

Which of the following sequence is correct for loss?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Loss on article L = 600 - 500 = 100

Loss on article M = 800 - 750 = 50

Loss on article N = 700 - 500 = 200

Loss on article O = 1000 - 700 = 300

Sequence according to loss = O > N > L > M

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
